goals.summary: Watch def 3 (orange). [RLCS; loose tier] Flip reset double tap from the floor: the reset touched the ball underneath the car 3.87 s after the takeoff, the dodge 0.93 s after the touch; the dodge's touch, 0.30 s after the dodge, sent it into the back wall beside the goal 1.30 s later; no second touch; the car was airborne at the bounce and came within 260 uu of the ball 0.47 s after it; no goal within 3 s.
